# DevSecOps Academy

Welcome to the DevSecOps Academy repository!

This is a modern documentation platform built with Next.js, TypeScript, and TailwindCSS.

## Quick Start

```bash
# Install dependencies
npm install

# Run development server
npm run dev
```

Open [http://localhost:3000](http://localhost:3000) to view the site.
